build_sparse_preprocessor: build a SparsePreprocessor from a ModelFeatureConfig to preprocess sparse id and id_score list features
create_hashing_map_id_list: create a HashingMapIDList mapper that hashes raw IDs into an embedding table of a given size
create_exact_map_id_list: create an ExactMapIDList mapper that passes raw IDs through unchanged without hashing
preprocess_id_list: preprocess a serving id list feature by mapping IDs through a configured mapper and moving tensors to device
preprocess_id_score_list: preprocess a serving id score list feature by mapping keys and weights through a configured mapper
